description: Pull the full exploration dossier around a point in ONE call: land/tenure status (is the ground open or held, and by whom?), nearby mines (MINEDEX) and known deposits, historical open-file drillholes, company drillhole & surface geochemistry (max Au/Cu + best downhole intercept), GSWA regional geochem, past WAMEX reports (each with an anumber: wamex_report_files or document_files gives its files), nearest mapped fault / magnetic & gravity worms, and past exploration activity. Returns a COMPACT summary of every section by default; pass `sections` for any of them in full detail.

metal.description: Optional; filters known deposits to this commodity (Au, Cu, Ni, W, Sn, Co, Ta, Mn, REE)

sections.description: Which sections to return in FULL detail. Omit for a compact summary of all. geochem = company drillhole/surface + GSWA assay anomalies; geology = host bedrock + regolith cover; landaccess = conservation reserves, native title, Indigenous Land Use Agreements (ILUAs) & pastoral leases; heritage = INDICATIVE Aboriginal heritage.

name: inspect_point
title: Inspect a point
